import re

def detect(cell):
    # Clean cells typically are simple business or place names without special structures
    dirty_patterns = [
        r'[\u0080-\uFFFF]',  # Special characters
        r'[^\w\s-]',  # Non-word characters
        r'\b(de|du|du pays du|le|la|en|au|des|du|dans|pour|Saint|Notre|Saint-Joseph|du Roi|du Pays|CMPA|CMP ENFANTS)\b',  # Institutional names
        r'\b(Centre|École|Mairie|Ecole|Centre Médico|CMP|Parapija|Fogarty\'s|Library|Marina|Archeologinė|Biblioteka|Kai sieloms neliko medžių)\b',  # Specific institution names
        r'\b(librairie|médiathèque|école|école maternelle)\b',  # French and other language institution names
        r'\b(Bureau|Posta|Ecole|Bibliothèque|Police municipale|ALDI|MOL)\b',  # Typical institution names in various languages
        r'^[A-Z]{3,}$',  # Long sequences of uppercase letters
        r'\(|\)',  # Parentheses
        r'\b(?:Ltd|GmbH|LLC|Inc)\b',  # Business type suffixes
        r'\b[A-Z]{2,}\b(?![a-z])',  # Multiple uppercase words which are not typical business names
    ]
    
    if any(re.search(pattern, cell, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in dirty_patterns):
        return True
    if len(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', cell)) > 2:
        return True  # More than two words typically indicates an institutional or place name
    return False

import re

def detect(cell):
    # General pattern for clean postcodes:
    # Starts with a digit and can include digits, letters, '-', '.', spaces, and some special characters like 'T' or 'V'
    # The length varies but typically has a pattern seen in the clean list
    clean_pattern = re.compile(r'^[0-9A-Za-z-\.\sTJV]{3,10}$')
    if clean_pattern.match(cell):
        return False
    return True

import re

def detect(cell):
    clean_patterns = [
        r'^France$',  # Exact match for France
        r'^Schweiz|Suisse|Svizzera|Svizra$',  # Swisstern countries in different languages
        r'^United Kingdom$',  # United Kingdom
        r'^Polska$',  # Poland
        r'^Lietuva$',  # Lithuania
        r'^Magyarország$',  # Hungary
        r'^United States$',  # United States
        r'^Deutschland$',  # Germany
        r'^Италия|ИТАЛИЯ|ITALIA$',  # Italy in Russian and Latin
        r'^Сербия|Србија$',  # Serbia in Russian and Serbian
        r'^Россия$',  # Russia
        r'^USA$',  # USA
        r'^UK$',  # UK
    ]
    for pattern in clean_patterns:
        if re.match(pattern, cell, re.IGNORECASE):
            return False
    return True
